title: FightSafe AI: Availability-Aware Interpretable Temporal Event Pipeline
description: FightSafe AI v2.0.0 research software for an availability-aware interpretable temporal event pipeline (Zenodo version DOI https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.23003746). The GitHub repository itself is the official software package: frozen canonical results (run_20260730_005150), configs, aggregation schemes with explicit availability masking, Tier A regeneration scripts, environment freeze and checksums. Companion manuscripts, when used, are maintained separately. Not a safety-certified system; not a state-of-the-art detector claim; not a medical device. Synthetic missingness only. Restricted video, skeleton keypoints and features_cache are not redistributed.
